preamble.title: Guessing game assurance
preamble.description: Generated claims about the compiled guessing-game rule.

ual.name: Universal Annotation Language
ual.description: Property specification language used by Blaster.

formalFragments.source:
def hashMatches (actual guess : ByteString) : Prop :=
  actual = PlutusCore.Crypto.Hash.sha2_256 guess

statement.text: A guess whose hash matches the datum terminates successfully for every context.

formal.source:
∀ (actual guess : ByteString) (ctx : Data), hashMatches actual guess →
      isSuccessful (gameValidator (Data.B actual) (Data.B guess) ctx)

statement.text: A guess whose hash differs from the datum fails script evaluation for every context.

formal.source:
∀ (actual guess : ByteString) (ctx : Data), ¬ hashMatches actual guess →
      isUnsuccessful (gameValidator (Data.B actual) (Data.B guess) ctx)

statement.text: An integer datum fails to decode as the stored hash, for every redeemer and context.
